purpose: Asks the ontology master how an address is spelled: the claim types, the attributes and the labels of the free-text lines.
namedChanges: The imports: the master is `term-slots`, the part-type registry is `lws-vault-sets`.

`PlaceVocabUnavailableError` carries `missing`, the terms that were not answered (new). Its message names term paths, which are technical ids: a view says a fixed sentence and keeps this for the log (F3).
The module header is reworded with the same facts. No other code changed.
